name: Odoo v20
description: Open-source business management software suite designed to streamline various aspects of business operations. With its modular structure, users can choose and integrate specific applications such as accounting, inventory, and sales. Odoo provides a user-friendly interface, scalability for businesses of all sizes, and is available in both community (free) and enterprise editions. Its integrated approach and customization options make it a popular choice for comprehensive ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-odoo-v20:
    container_name: big-bear-odoo-v20
    image: odoo:20@sha256:d5e3a26baa044867c826dddc09058f10e2582706bf83c146ea04fea889720c76
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: root
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/etc:/etc/odoo
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/addons:/mnt/extra-addons
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/filestore:/var/lib/odoo
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8069"
    environment:
      - HOST=big-bear-odoo-v20-db
      - USER=odoo
      - PASSWORD=${SECRET_PASSWORD}
    networks:
      - big-bear-odoo-v20-network
  big-bear-odoo-v20-db:
    container_name: big-bear-odoo-v20-db
    image: postgres:16@sha256:be01cf82fc7dbba824acf0a82e150b4b360f3ff93c6631d7844af431e841a95c
    user: root
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=odoo
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data/postgresql:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - big-bear-odoo-v20-network
networks:
  big-bear-odoo-v20-network:
    driver: bridge
